newsitem.title: POLAND: Alte Leipziger has 75 pct in Polish insurer.
newsitem.headline: Alte Leipziger has 75 pct in Polish insurer.

text.p: Germany's Alte Leipziger Europa AG created a new Polish insurance company, Hestia Life SA, with Polish Bank Rozwoju Exportu (BRE) and Hestia Insurance SA, taking a 75 percent stake in the new firm, BRE said.
BRE has 15 percent and Hestia Insurance SA 10 percent of Hestia Life SA, which has a capital of 10 million zlotys divided into one million registered shares of a nominal value of 10 zlotys each.
"The legal act creating the company has been signed on January 27," BRE said in a statement.

"On Januray 28 the company received a finance ministry licence to conduct insurance business in the life, pension and reinsurance sectors as well as other business activities connected to insurance," the statement said.
Hestia Insurance SA is itself a subsidary of the German insurer Alte Leipziger Europa in which the German compay has an 88 percent stake. BRE is owned in 21 percent by Germany's Commerzbank.
